name: The Glass Garden of Singing Crystals
description: A vast garden where every flower, leaf, and blade of grass is made of delicate, translucent glass that chimes softly with the breeze, creating an ethereal symphony.
prompt: An incredibly detailed and whimsical fantasy scene of a magical garden where every plant is crafted from delicate, translucent glass. Flowers of every color—ruby red, sapphire blue, emerald green—glow softly with internal light. Tall grass made of fine glass strands sways and chimes. Vines of crystal wind around glass tree trunks, and delicate glass butterflies with stained-glass wings flutter between the blooms. Sunlight streams through the glass plants, casting colorful prisms and rainbows across the lush green lawn. The atmosphere is serene and musical, as if the garden itself is singing. Ultra-realistic rendering with soft focus and light rays.
caption: In a world of whispers and wonder, even the flowers know the sweetest songs. Listen closely... can you hear the garden sing? 🎶🌈
